title: fix(service-analytics): a truncated query_dataset answer carries drill sidecars for the served rows only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoF1nguV8Pdh9hoikrSfbcXx)_

Fixes #32944

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 调用 `query_dataset`（MCP 工具和产品内 AI 对话工具共用同一个执行器）在按 `limit` 截断结果时，`drillRawRows` 和 `drillRanges` 这两个按行对齐的钻取附表现在与 `rows` 一起截到同样长度，第 i 项对应第 i 行。
- 为什么改：工具为了判断 `truncated` 会多取一行，过去只把 `rows` 截掉，附表原样返回，于是 `limit: 1` 时有 1 行却有 2 条 `drillRawRows`，客户端按下标钻取会多出一个看不到的分组。
- 风险与回滚：很小。只影响被截断的回答；未截断的回答完全不变（有对照用例）；`totals`、`drillRawTotals`、`dimensionFields`、`drillScopes` 不按行对齐，保持原样。回滚 = revert 本 PR，不涉及数据。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts` 新增的 `ROW_ALIGNED_ANSWER_MEMBERS` 常量和 `queryDataset` 中截断后的循环；`src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts` 新增的 `a truncated answer serves every row-aligned sidecar` 一组用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts`，预期 32/32 通过，其中 4 条 `row-aligned sidecar` 用例为绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/service-analytics`**: `createDatasetTools(...).queryDataset` asks the service for `cap + 1` rows so `truncated` is a fact, and serves `cap`. It now serves the answer's row-aligned members to the same length as `rows` when it truncates. They are listed once, in `ROW_ALIGNED_ANSWER_MEMBERS`, typed against `keyof AnalyticsResult`.
- **The sidecars, enumerated from `AnalyticsResult` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts`):**
  - Aligned to `rows` by index, trimmed: `drillRawRows` ("aligned to `rows` by index") and `drillRanges` ("aligned to `rows` by index").
  - Not row-indexed, served as answered: `fields` (one entry per column), `totals` (one per requested grouping, computed over the underlying data, not the capped rows), `drillRawTotals` (aligned to `totals`), `dimensionFields` and `drillScopes` (keyed by dimension or measure name), `object`. `sql` is still stripped.
- **One fix, both faces.** The MCP `query_dataset` tool (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`) and the chat tool (`execute`) call this executor, so both are fixed here.
- **The REST door has no over-read.** `POST /analytics/dataset/query` (`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts`) passes the caller's `selection` to `AnalyticsService.queryDataset` unchanged and does not truncate, so its `rows` and sidecars come from one query at one limit. No change there.

## Tests

`packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts` (+4, one `describe` in the `query_dataset` block):

- `limit: 1` and `limit: 2`, through the plugin-wired service: `truncated: true`, `rowCount` equals the limit, `drillRawRows.length === rows.length`, and `drillRawRows[i]` equals `{ stage: rows[i].stage }` for every i.
- A service answer carrying every sidecar (`limit: 2` over three rows): `drillRawRows` and `drillRanges` keep their first two entries; `totals`, `drillRawTotals`, `dimensionFields` and `drillScopes` equal the service's answer.
- CONTROL: `limit: 3` over three rows: `truncated: false`, and `rows` and `drillRawRows` equal the service's own answer.

## Acceptance notes

- Ruling grep on the touched surface (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`): `dataset-tools.ts` L295 and its test L472/L513 cite the admission-first ruling 6766102988 (which holders are candidates). The change runs after resolution and names no holder, so it does not touch that ruling.
- Not changed: a `limit: 0` call (cap 0) serves no rows, but `dimensionFields` and `drillScopes` stay on the answer, though their contract says they are set only on an answer with rows. `drillRawRows` / `drillRanges` are now `[]` there. This is a narrow edge that nobody has reported; left as is.
- New row-aligned members: a future `AnalyticsResult` member aligned to `rows` has to be added to `ROW_ALIGNED_ANSWER_MEMBERS`. The `satisfies` check catches a misspelled or removed key at compile time, but it cannot tell whether a new key is row-aligned.
- Live reproduction: the card's showcase MCP run (QA #32940 P-1) was not repeated here. The unit pins drive the plugin-wired service, whose `drillRawRows` comes from the same `analytics-service.ts` pass the showcase uses.

## Verification

All readings at head `bbc366d8` (base `bf02d33b`; `origin/main` merged before the PR, already up to date).

<details><summary>Measured at origin/main first (the premise holds)</summary>

New pins over the unfixed executor (`bf02d33b`), `-t 'row-aligned sidecar'`: **3 failed | 1 passed (4)**.

- `limit 1`: `expected [ { stage: 'draft' }, …(2) ] to have a length of 1 but got 3`
- `limit 2`: `expected [ { stage: 'draft' }, …(2) ] to have a length of 2 but got 3`
- sidecars: `drillRawRows` kept three entries where two rows were served.

The engine double returns every row it holds, so at `limit: 1` the measured surplus is two entries, not one. On a SQL driver, which applies `LIMIT cap + 1`, it is the single probe row the card shows. The CONTROL passed.

</details>
